title: Executive Decision
description: A commando squad must conduct a midair assault upon a hijacked plane loaded with terrorists and a deadly nerve gas.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: Clara's Heart
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) befriends the teenage son of the bickering Baltimore couple (Michael Ontkean, Kathleen Quinlan) who brought her from Jamaica.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Barcelona
description: Women and Cold War politics surround a U.S. sales rep (Taylor Nichols) and his Navy-officer cousin (Chris Eigeman) in Spain.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
description: A mysterious man (Anthony Hopkins) with a very rare ability enters the lives of a widow (Hope Davis) and her son (Anton Yelchin) in Connecticut.

title: Mama's Boy
description: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
description: A nightclub owner finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob; the lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.

title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.

title: Before Sunrise
description: An American (Ethan Hawke) and a Frenchwoman (Julie Delpy) meet on a train and spend a romantic day and night in Vienna.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: Black Beauty
description: Based on Anna Sewell's novel about a horse in Victorian England and its often cruel treatment by various owners.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Corrina, Corrina
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) brings joy to a Jewish widower (Ray Liotta) and his young daughter (Tina Majorino) in 1959 Los Angeles.

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: Their mixed-up family follows when an unhappy teen (Hillary Wolf) and her stepbrother flee into the woods.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: Suburban Commando
description: A warrior (Hulk Hogan) from another galaxy escapes to Earth and moves in with an architect (Christopher Lloyd) and his wife (Shelley Duvall).

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: El cantante
description: Puerto Rican singer Héctor Lavoe (Marc Anthony) becomes a pioneer of salsa music in the United States while coping with an ever-growing dependence on drugs.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: Graffiti Bridge
description: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
description: To embarrass his rival, a scheming senator (Lawrence Dane) uses nitwit Ohio teens who are invited to a Washington gathering on educational failure.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Evil Mage Profion (Jeremy Irons) seeks Empress Savina's (Thora Birch) magic scepter in his quest to overtake the kingdom of Izmer for his group of magic users.

title: Protocol
description: A Washington waitress saves the Emir of Ohtar's life, launching her diplomatic career and a scandal.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: The Year of Living Dangerously
description: An Australian reporter (Mel Gibson) betrays his friend (Linda Hunt) and his lover (Sigourney Weaver) in volatile 1965 Indonesia.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.
